releases.notes:
fixed an issue where I was using the wrong logic to check whether quests could be completed.
fixed an issue where unlocked quests were not updating.
fixed an issue where advancements would lose their icon leading to a crash. #5 
fixed an issue where advancement checks would be sent after completing any part of an advancement (getting adventuring time's check for going to any biome).

use translatable strings rather than being hardcoded.
fixed an issue where deathlinks were being sent without deathlink being enabled.
advancements are now visible before connecting for the first time.

fixed an issue where the minimum amount of checks required for a dependency could be more than the amount of checks in the dependency.
fixed an issue where quest/chapter names did not match in game and in the generated json. 
remove advancements from generated json when the root doesn't have display instead of just looking at the parent (goodbye occultism ritual advancements).

moved version independant logic to an embedded library [Archipelago Lib](https://github.com/Stuff691734/archipelago-lib).
- hopefully this hasn't broken any existing functionallity, but there is a solid chance I have and missed it in my testing.
- this should make it easier for me to make updates and update to new versions.
